title: Peril options in the user interface
text:
Peril options in the user interface

Each peril has different options in the user interface.
The perils and sub-perils that are available depend on the models you have licensed and on
 the version of 
Touchstone
.

Earthquake
: Earthquake Shake (ES), Fire Following (FF), Sprinkler Leakage
 (SL), Landslide (LS), Tsunami (TS) Liquefaction (LQ)

Tropical Cyclone
: Wind (TC), Storm Surge (AIR) (SU), Precipitation Flood
 (PF)

Severe Storm
: Severe Thunderstorm (ST) [sub-perils: Hail (HL), Straight-Line
 Winds (SW), Tornado (TD)], Winter Storm (WS)

Inland Flood

Wildfire/Bushfire:
 Sub-perils: Wildfire and Smoke).

Terrorism

Coastal flood

Note:
 Non-catastrophe (NC): We retired non-catastrophe loss analyses in
 
Touchstone
 2021 (9.0). Therefore, these
 fields do not affect losses.
